### Added

- **Windows Hello** (Windows desktop): Privacy & security can wrap this device's database key in Windows Hello — PIN, face, or fingerprint — and remove the Credential Manager copy. Cold start stays locked until Hello succeeds. The app-lock PIN can stay as the other way in. The button stays hidden when Hello is not set up on this Windows account.

### Fixed

- **Large chats no longer freeze the app.** The "N replies" count scanned the chat twice, and each open started another copy until the database pool was full. The lookup now uses the message-id index, and the chat view runs one of those counts at a time.
- **Restart core** runs one at a time. Stopping mail gives up after 15 seconds and starts again anyway. A database statement that has already started still runs to the end — quit an app that is already stuck on an older build.
- The core watchdog no longer raises its banner for calls that are slow on purpose (backup, adding a relay, calls). A frozen clock counts as the app coming back, and a timed-out call stops counting after 2 minutes.
- The core banner sits below the Android status bar.

### Under the hood

- Design system: selection, accent tint, and the keyboard focus ring are their own tokens. The light theme's focus ring is `#1a68b8` (5.1:1). `docs/design-tokens.html` is generated from `app/css/main.css`. The public design page does not embed that fragment yet.
- `sqlite3_interrupt` is not wired. The statement that filled the pool is gone, and an interrupt would roll back the write transaction on that connection. Add it when a `core slow sql` line still owns a pool slot after Restart returns.
- Quilt is 188 ops / 37 files. Suite: 198 files / 1332 tests.
